etymology.historical_story: This token has no established Malay origin in the supplied evidence. German does have the noun Feier, meaning a celebration or ceremonial observance, with a history traced through earlier German forms to Latin. That resemblance is a research lead, not proof that the corpus token is German. [Duden](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Feier)
